newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sub Nigel says agrees computer firm buy.
newsitem.headline: Sub Nigel says agrees computer firm buy.

text.p: Sub Nigel Gold Mining Co Ltd said on Tuesday conditional heads of agreement had been reached for the purchase of a business that supplies goods and services in the information technology industry.
It gave no further details of the buy but said in the cautionary announcement that negotiations regarding further acquisitions in this industry were taking place.

Sub Nigel said it planned to transfer its listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange to the electronics and electrical sector and talks were accordingly taking place for the disposal of its mining interests.
